post_operation: assign error code to ret before goto cleanup label
path_conditions: error path taken via `goto advance_rx` when idr_find returns NULL; function exits with `return ret` and ret was only initialized to 0
description: Function qcom_glink_rx_data initializes int ret = 0; on an error path (idr_find returns NULL for intent), code does `goto advance_rx` without assigning a negative errno to ret. The label leads to `return ret`, so the caller receives 0 (success) on a real failure. Fix sets ret = -ENOENT before the goto.
